use_when.text: Set an arrow to Hover through its nested instance to show the pointer over it.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use Pagination Arrow on its own outside Pagination.

variant_intent.intent: Pagination Arrow, Direction Previous. Disabled on the first page.
Pagination Arrow, Direction Next. Disabled on the last page.
Set an arrow to Hover through its nested instance to show the pointer over it.
Use the disabled attribute on the arrow that cannot be used.

placement.text: Pagination pager: Previous then Next; Previous is Disabled on First and Next is Disabled on Last.

pairs_with.how: chevron-left (Previous) or chevron-right (Next) Icon at Size md

a11y.text: Renders a native <button> with type="button" by default.
aria-label is set by Direction to "Previous page" or "Next page" and cannot be overridden.
State Disabled sets the native disabled attribute.
The chevron Icon has no Label, so it is aria-hidden.
Make each arrow a button with aria-label="Previous page" or "Next page".
Use the disabled attribute on the arrow that cannot be used.
The summary is above 4.5:1. Active arrow icons are above 3:1. Disabled arrows are exempt.

gaps.detail: State=Default: the Pagination documentation page (156:27), which holds the Pagination Arrow set does not say what this value is for (checked usage region 156:262).

Pagination Arrow has no documentation page of its own; its entries are the rules on the Pagination documentation page (156:27), which holds the Pagination Arrow set that name Pagination Arrow or its variants. Rules written for the Pagination as a whole are not copied.
